records.name: busybox
records.command: busybox 2>&1 | head -n 1; for x in awk stat readlink sha256sum base64 tar dd ip iptables netstat dropbear dropbearkey opkg; do command -v "$x"; done

records.name: release
records.command: for f in /etc/openwrt_release /etc/os-release; do if [ -r "$f" ]; then grep -E '^(ID|NAME|VERSION_ID|DISTRIB_ID|DISTRIB_RELEASE|DISTRIB_CODENAME|DISTRIB_TARGET|DISTRIB_DESCRIPTION)=' "$f"; fi; done

records.name: mounts
records.command: awk '{print $1, $2, $3, $4}' /proc/mounts | awk '{if ($3 ~ /^(jffs2|tmpfs|ramfs|rootfs|proc|sysfs|devpts|squashfs|overlay|overlayfs|ubifs)$/) print; else print "[other source]","[other mountpoint]",$3,"[options withheld]"}'

records.name: processes
records.command: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$d/comm" ] || continue; n=$(cat "$d/comm"); case "$n" in dropbear|tdsmgr|ams_cli|init|telnetd|uhttpd) printf '%s %s ' "${d##*/}" "$n"; awk '/^(PPid|Uid|Gid):/{printf "%s ",$0} END {print ""}' "$d/status"; esac; done

records.name: ssh_metadata
records.command: for d in /etc/dropbear /.ssh /root/.ssh /var/.ssh; do ls -ld "$d" 2>/dev/null; done; for p in /etc/dropbear/* /.ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /var/.ssh/authorized_keys; do [ -e "$p" ] && ls -ld "$p"; done
